dish: Paleo chicken and vegetable tray bake

canonicalIngredients.name: chicken thighs
observations: 1.5-2 lb bone-in skin-on thighs, or 1 lb boneless (s1)

canonicalIngredients.name: sweet potato
observations: 12 oz cubed, named sub for baby red potatoes (s1)

causalSequence: preheat oven hot (200-230 C); line large tray
chop veg to even chunks; keep sweet potato small so it cooks through
toss veg with olive oil, herbs, salt directly on tray
nestle chicken among veg, sitting slightly on top
stagger option: roast chicken + sweet potato 10 min before adding quick-cooking veg
roast 30-35 min, stir veg and turn chicken once, until chicken cooked through and veg tender
techniqueFacts: all four sources land on ~1.5 lb (700 g) chicken for the tray
paleo compliance: no grain, legume, or dairy ingredient in any source; roasting fat is olive or avocado oil in all four
paleo swap pattern: one source replaces soy sauce with coconut aminos and sweetens with blended dates instead of sugar (s0)
sweet potato is the paleo-compliant tray starch; white potato appears in two sources (baby red s1/s2, russet s3) but strict paleo excludes it — s1 explicitly offers sweet potato as the swap
green beans appear in one source (s1) despite being legume-family — tolerated on Whole30, excluded under strict paleo
bone-in skin-on thighs hold up best to high-heat roasting (s1); boneless thighs pair with the 450 F fast method (s0)
oven temp trades against time: 450 F = ~25 min roast (s0), 425 F = 30-35 min (s1, s2), 400 F = 50-60 min (s3)
staggered veg add (dense first, quick veg after 10 min) keeps broccoli and capsicum from overcooking (s0)
broiler finish for browning is held by two sources (s0, s2)
everything-on-one-tray toss with vinegar + herbs is the no-marinade shortcut; marinating 30 min is optional (s2)
